message.reasoning:
I am evaluating a Monopoly trade offer from player p4.

The offer drops to $350 for two mortgaged properties. I have $1041 cash and fully built pinks. Liquidation is roughly $1861. Rent on Pennsylvania Avenue is $1300. The BW hotel needs about $139 more.

Accepting the offer would leave me with $691 cash and $1511 liquidation. The BW hotel gap would widen to $489. I would complete the orange set, but unmortgaging St. James Place costs $99 and New York Avenue costs $110.

Unmortgaging the orange set would cost $308. The bank currently has no houses available, so building a full set is impossible. This trade would also give p4 $350 cash, which they could use to hotel their light blues and free up houses for other players.

p4 currently has only $14 cash and cannot survive a $700 hit even after liquidation. The $350 offer would let them survive such a loss. Their holdings include four houses on the light blues, two unmortgaged railroads, and several mortgaged properties.

p4's liquidation totals $514 without the trade. Adding $350 would raise it to $864, allowing them to pay the $700 Virginia rent and survive. This is a major strategic loss; I want them bankrupt when they hit my pinks.

After unmortgaging the orange set, I would have only $383 left. I cannot build houses without bank stock. This leaves me more exposed to Boardwalk. A counter-trade is unlikely to help. p4 has no cash and no light blue monopoly to offer. Their railroads are not useful.

I own no green properties. Completing the green set for p4 would be harmful. I cannot counter with $0 or free oranges because p4 needs cash to survive.

Free mortgaged properties would block p4 from using the orange set and leave the set ready for future building, but the current offer is $350. I should reject or counter at a price that does not hurt me.

The best counter would be $0 or a cash-for-light-blues swap, but p4 will not give up their light blue monopoly. I will reject the offer. The trade still widens the Boardwalk gap and gives p4 enough cash to survive Virginia rent.

The orange set is strategically irrelevant. p4 cannot complete it without my Tennessee property. Building from zero houses would cost over $1500, which I cannot afford without selling my pink houses. Denying them the set does not change the outcome.
